Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human prostaglandin G/H synthase 2 (CHEMBL230). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL230 and standard_type IC50. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to get compound_key. Join docs on compound_records.doc_id to get pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno to get canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
